newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - U.S. Robotics up on Dell news.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - U.S. Robotics up on Dell news.

text.p: Shares of U.S. Robotics Corp moved higher in U.S. pre-opening trade on Friday after the computer modem maker said Dell Computer Corp will offer its products in new Dell computers.

Shares of U.S. Robotics added 1/4 to the Wednesday close of 73-1/2. On Wednesday, U.S. Robotics said Dell will include the Sportster U.S. Robotics internal modem in Dell's Dimension systems early next year.
Shares of ElectroStarInc rose 5/8 from the Wesnesday close of $13 after Tyco International Ltd said early Friday it would buy the maker of printed circuit boards for $14 per share.
Traders said that overall pre-open activity was very light as many on Wall Street chose to extend the U.S. Thanksgiving Day Holiday.
